title: UniversalManifest
description: Blueprint for an AI Voice Engine. The Engine publishes this JSON at /manifest for the Go gateway to consume. See GATEWAY.md for the resolution rules.

engine_id.description: Unique identifier for the engine, e.g. 'core-tts-example-v1'

engine_name.description: Human-readable engine name, e.g. 'Example TTS Engine'

supported_modes.description: List of processing modes this engine supports (e.g. fast, standard, clone).

capabilities.description: Engine-wide capability defaults. Modes that state nothing inherit these.

audio_spec.description: Engine-wide audio output defaults. Modes may override individual fields.

ui_schema.description: UI layout configuration. Optional — the platform uses defaults when absent.

EngineCapabilities.description: What an engine (or mode) can do. nil = inherit, false = explicitly off, true = on.

supports_preset_voices.description: Engine ships with preset voice options

supports_voice_saving.description: Save cloned voices to user account

supports_streaming.description: Stream audio chunks as they are generated

capabilities.description: Per-mode capability overrides. Only state fields that differ from the engine-wide default.

audio_spec.description: Per-mode audio spec overrides. Only state fields that differ.

AudioSpec.description: Audio output format and reference-audio constraints. At the engine level, all fields should be filled; at the mode level, only overrides.

supported_formats.description: Output formats the engine can produce, e.g. ['wav', 'mp3']

supported_sample_rates.description: Sample rates the engine supports, e.g. [24000, 44100]

default_format.description: Default output format, must be in supported_formats

default_sample_rate.description: Default sample rate, must be in supported_sample_rates

reference_audio_formats.description: Input formats the engine accepts for reference/cloning audio — distinct from output formats

reference_audio_seconds.description: How many seconds of reference audio the engine expects for cloning

max_upload_bytes.description: Maximum raw file size the user may upload (before trimming), in bytes

max_reference_bytes.description: Maximum clip size after trimming, in bytes

max_text_length.description: Maximum characters per synthesis request, default 3000

max_chunk_size.description: Preferred chunk size. The platform will chunk text into fragments at most this size.

delimiters.description: Ordered list of regex split patterns, most preferred first. The platform tries each then hard-cuts.

UISchemaSpec.description: UI layout configuration. Optional — the platform uses defaults when absent.

ui_mode.description: UI mode: 'beauty' for full visuals, 'fast' for minimal mode

model_sort.description: Ordered list of mode IDs controlling tab display order

option_panel.description: Per-mode option panel configuration, keyed by mode ID

auto_format.description: Automatic text replacement rules applied before synthesis

ModelOptionSpec.description: Presentation-only: how controls are drawn, not whether they exist.

voice_metadata_schema.description: Schema for user-created voice metadata fields

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata (gender, region, style, etc.)

sample_url.description: URL to a sample audio clip

type.description: Field type: 'text' for text input, 'select' for dropdown
